description: This file provides an abstract base implementation for the JsonValue interface, defining common behavior and default methods for JSON value types, facilitating the creation of concrete JSON value classes.

classes.name: AbstractJsonValue
classes.description: An abstract class implementing JsonValue that provides default implementations for type checks and value access methods, designed to be extended by concrete JSON value classes.

methods.name: AbstractJsonValue
methods.description: Constructor for the abstract JSON value class.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is null; defaults to false.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is a boolean; defaults to false.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is a number; defaults to false.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is an integer; defaults to false.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is a long; defaults to false.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is a double; defaults to false.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is a string; defaults to false.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is an object; defaults to false.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON value is an array; defaults to false.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a boolean; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as an int; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a long; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a double; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a string; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonObject; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonArray; throws UnsupportedOperationException by default.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Abstract method to convert JSON value to string; must be implemented by subclasses. Annotated as Nonnull.
